the MetS is a syndrome of five components (obesity, dyslipidemia, elevated blood pressure, insulin resistance, and pro-inflammatory state), which are all related to each other, and that sleep disturbances, especially short sleep duration, are an integral part of the MetS.

the MetS is a hierarchical 5- factor structure that includes sleep disturbance measures.

the development and testing of the hierarchical 5-factor (H5F) model of the metabolic (syndrome Z) syndrome.
the development and validation of a new hierarchical model of the metabolic risk factors that comprise the metabolic syndrome (syndrome Z) that incorporates sleep disturbance measures.

the identification of the most appropriate statistical models for describing the relationships between the components of the metabolic syndrome, with a particular interest in the role of sleep disturbance in the syndrome.
